fi-apistogramma-cacatuoides.title: Apistogramma Cacatouides Cichlid
fi-apistogramma-cacatuoides.summary: The cockatoo cichlid, Apistogramma cacatuoides, is a small cichlid from the upper Amazon basin, from the Ucayali in Peru to the Solimões in Brazil. It lives in slow tributaries, backwaters and creeks…
rows: Usually kept singly (or a known pair when breeding)
Omnivore. Primarily carnivorous and apparently feeds mostly on benthic invertebrates in nature.
The type locality was originally given incorrectly as Paramaribo, Suriname but this was later amended by Kullander to the " Amazon River basin, between 69°W and 71°W".
notes: Provided adequate cover and structure is available this species is unfussy with regards to décor with ceramic flowerpots, lengths of plastic piping and other artificial materials all useful additions.
A more natural-looking arrangement might consist of a soft, sandy substrate with wood roots and branches placed such a way that plenty of shady spots and caves are formed.
